label: DA

notes.grounding: All claims about the script hold: the options, 'Overall Completion: N%' at line 348, the unconditional exit 0 at line 587, the exit-code comment listing only 0 and 1, the 'ERROR: Unexpected argument: 90' rejection (--min-percent is taken as SPEC_FOLDER, then 90 is unexpected), the local percentage that output_text computes at lines 376-387, and the --file not-found early return.
notes.requirements: REQ-001 to REQ-007 are testable and cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical text and JSON output, missing/non-integer/out-of-range values (exit 1, stderr ERROR, no report) and --file gating.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause with a command and expected output, but T007, T011 and T013 pass the fixture file $X as a positional spec folder; the real script fails that with 'ERROR: Spec folder not found' and exit 1 (confirmed by running it on a file path), so a correct implementation would fail those checks. T014's 'missing value' case passes $P as the value, so it tests a non-integer value and never the missing-value branch.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1 and adds no subsystem. No unfilled tokens or filler sections.
notes.consistency: Exit codes, paths and numbers mostly agree, but tasks.md runs the fixture as a 'folder run' using a file path while spec REQ-002 and plan.md speak of a below-threshold folder/scratch fixture, and plan.md line 56 says '--min-percent|-m-style' handling although spec.md line 79 puts the -m alias out of scope.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement the change from plan.md section 3 (globals, both output functions, gate replacing exit 0, default 0 for not-found). The broken fixture invocations would cause confusion during verification.

defects: tasks.md:52: T007 Verify runs 'bash $S --min-percent 100 $X' with $X a file (scratch/fixture/spec.md) as the positional spec folder; the script exits 1 with 'ERROR: Spec folder not found', so the expected 3 never appears even after a correct implementation (needs --file $X or the fixture directory)
tasks.md:63: T011 is titled a folder run but passes the file $X positionally; the same 'Spec folder not found' exit 1 makes the expected 3 unreachable
tasks.md:65: T013 'bash $S --min-percent 0 $X' exits 1 for the same reason, not the expected 0
tasks.md:66: T014 second case 'bash $S --min-percent $P' consumes $P as the value, so it tests a non-integer value, not the missing-value case REQ-005 requires (spec.md:107)
plan.md:56: says '--min-percent|-m-style handling of the long form only', which muddles the -m alias that spec.md:79 places out of scope
